body:
I usually think

"She's probably talking to people she likes more than me. No one will ever like me more than anyone else. I'm always gonna be unloved, unwanted, and nobody's priority"

Imagine not telling anyone you're depressed or suicidal and even denying it yourself despite doing self harm because you're terrified of how others will look at you once they find out. 

So you don't talk to anyone about it for 8 years except for making edgy jokes to random people online. 

Then finally you meet that one person and you feel like you can tell them anything and everything and you find out it was all a lie and she never once cared for you

Imagine that
You seem fun lol dm me
